messages:
maria: quick design sync after today's alpha sessions — two recurring items: token counter clarity & accidental stop taps on narrow widths. jotting here. kevin: thanks. can you describe the accidental taps? is stop overlapping the meter? maria: exactly. at 1024 width the meter's padding extends over the stop icon by a few px. users hit meter instead of stop. sam: dev note: the meter adds an animated width on stream start which expands the hitbox. cheap fix: pointer-events:none on the non-interactive area + reserve space so it doesn't jump. ali: UX idea: keep Stop as a prominent single-tap control (44px min). move Regenerate into kebab menu so we don't crowd the primary action. users expect stop to be visible. olga: accessibility: hover-only details break keyboard/screenreader. make the token breakdown reachable via keyboard (tab to token element) and expose aria-live for streaming token updates. avoid focus traps when opening the hover panel. kevin: microcopy: change label to "Stop output" (shorter). hovercard header: "Estimated tokens (approx.)". include tiny export icon to send current prompt to Prompt Library. maria: agree on copy. also request hovercard show componentized breakdown: Prompt Context Session totals. keep numbers rounded. sam: implementation plan: render hovercard in a portal (no reflow), reserve a 48px action slot to avoid layout shifts, add Esc keyboard shortcut to stop when pane focused. I'll prototype and run perf tests with 512 token streams. ali: mobile: token hover should become tap-to-open panel; ensure stop is big enough and has clear aria-label. olga: small code examples for team: ```css @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .spinner{ animation:none; } } ``` ```html
Streaming 120 tokens (est)
``` kevin: i'll mock collapsed / focused / mobile states and include the export flow. deploy-bot: playground v2 staging deployed (sha: 8d2f1) :rocket: maria: next steps: kevin mock, sam PR, ali copy flows, olga a11y check, quick 3-user test next week. assigning owners in the tickets. :thumbsup:
